lines.en: I glide low along the reef.
My fins ripple like a fringed edge.

lines.zh: 颜色一变，我就隐进礁里。
lines.en: One color shift hides me in the reef.

lines.zh: 浅海的沙子在我下面流。
lines.en: Shallow sand streams beneath me.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，眼睛分开看两边。
lines.en: I slide sideways, eyes watching both ways.

lines.zh: 温水浅滩里，我走得很轻。
lines.en: In warm shallows I move lightly.
My arms reach, then my body follows.
I round a clump of red coral.
The current turns me a new way.
Six points of health lets me take my time.

lines.zh: 鳞片似的斑在我背上游。
lines.en: Scale-like spots crawl over my back.
I turn on my side through a reef gap.
A faint trail stays on the sand.

lines.zh: 我退着进洞，腕足最后收。
lines.en: I back into a hole, arms last.

lines.zh: 我把腕足收成一束，往前推水
lines.en: I gather my arms into a bundle and push forward.

lines.zh: 礁石背面暗，我压低了身子
lines.en: The back of the reef is dark, so I keep low.

lines.zh: 一只螃蟹在沙上爬，我跟了一小段
lines.en: A crab crosses the sand; I trail it briefly.

lines.zh: 我换个颜色，和身后的沙一样
lines.en: I change color to match the sand behind me.
I hover in the water, rocking with the waves.

lines.zh: 背上流过一道灰，又变回去。
lines.en: A gray band crosses my back and fades.

lines.zh: 我在礁石边挑了个好位置。
lines.en: I picked a good spot by the reef.

lines.zh: 腕足卷着一块小石头玩。
lines.en: My arms toy with a small stone.

lines.zh: 有只虾躲在珊瑚下看我。
lines.en: A shrimp watches me from under coral.

lines.zh: 我记得那条鲨鱼的味道。
lines.en: I remember that shark's smell.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在身体里发轻。
lines.en: The bone inside me feels light.

lines.zh: 暖流裹着我，我一步不想挪。
lines.en: Warm water wraps me; I will not budge.
I jet out a little water.
My eyes have never once closed.
Six points of health is not tough.
The reef shadow moved; so did I.

lines.zh: 我把自己收成一块石头。
lines.en: I fold myself into a stone.
In stillness I look most like coral.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到礁石上了。
lines.en: Your shadow is on my reef.
You looked at me three times; I counted.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两边，都在看你。
lines.en: Both my eyes are on you.
I see the net bag swaying in your hand.
Do not come in; I will hide.

lines.zh: 你的脚蹼踩坏了一片珊瑚。
lines.en: Your fins crushed a patch of coral.

lines.zh: 我变了个颜色，你发现了吗？
lines.en: I changed color; did you notice?
You are standing somewhere very obvious.
I know the knife-carrying two-legs.
Stand there a while and I might trust you.
I squirt ink and hide first.
A piece of arm is gone, still twitching.
My bone has been cracked.
Six points draining makes me panic.
Pain scrambles my colors.
Who bit me? I remember the taste.
I press to the reef and flatten out.
The ink clears; the water stays red.
Do not chase; I have more ink.
I shrink into the hole, eyes only.
A crab is moving under that stone.
I smell shrimp, very near.
Did you put a crab on the reef?
That crustacean is too small.
I head for that stirring in the sand.
The warm shallows have the most crabs.

lines.zh: 你的手在礁缝里翻什么？
lines.en: What are you turning up in that gap?
My arms have already reached out.
I am not picky; hard shells will do.
Hold still and let me see clearly.

lines.zh: 你撞得我喷了一小股墨。
lines.en: Your bump made me squirt a little ink.

lines.zh: 我贴在你腿上，颜色发白。
lines.en: I am pressed to your leg, pale as paper.
Do not shove; my bone could snap.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，腕足碰到你靴。
lines.en: I swerve, arms brushing your boot.
You caved in the hole I was hiding in.
One bump and the water is murky.
I curled into a ball and rolled away.
Clear the way; I am heading for the reef.
Your knee hit my back.
I change color and pretend it was nothing.
I brighten my patterns to the fullest.

lines.zh: 另一只在礁影里回应我。
lines.en: Another answers from the reef shadow.
We swim side by side, sideways.
Its arms are longer than mine.

lines.zh: 沙地上我们各挖一个坑。
lines.en: We dig a pit each in the sand.
I tuck the eggs into a coral gap.
It circled half around me.

lines.zh: 别过来，这时候我脾气差。
lines.en: Stay back; I am short-tempered now.

lines.zh: 颜色暗下来，仪式就完了。
lines.en: The colors dim, and it is over.

lines.zh: 我们分开，各自找石头躲。
lines.en: We part and each find a stone to hide in.
I hold it with two of my arms.
This shell suits me nicely.
I push it into a reef crack.

lines.zh: 拖了半片礁，腕足都酸了。
lines.en: I dragged it half the reef; my arms ache.
I will keep this shrimp shell.
A bright snail shell, mine now.
It fell; my arms fish it back.
I will take this one you dropped.
I have hidden three things; enough.
Who turned over my stone?
A shell is moving in the sand.
That crab has raised its claws.
I see a shrimp backing away.
The stirring under the reef is wrong.
The scent is strong, right there.
It ducked into a gap; I noted where.
This meal lasts me two days.
I flatten my fins and ease closer.
A crustacean never runs fast.
My target has curled into a ball.
I move up-current of it.
My arms have opened into a net.
When it pinches air, I move in.
I match the reef, color for color.
It has backed against the coral.

lines.zh: 我数它钳子开合的节奏。
lines.en: I count the rhythm of its claws.
Half a block more and my arms reach.
It cannot see me; perfect.
I wait for it to come out.
The warm water softens its shell.
My arms clamp down on it.
My beak bites into the shell seam.
It pinches my arm; I do not let go.
The shell cracks; soft inside.
I jet ink over it to blind it.
It thrashes hard; I hold tighter.
One bite like this stops it.
I bit its claw clean off.
Blood spreads in fine threads.
I drop the shell under the reef.
I slip out of a coral crack.
My arms are soft; first I learn to hide.
Warm shallows, just the right light.

lines.zh: 这片礁石只有我一只乌贼。
lines.en: I am the only cuttlefish on this reef.
I change color for the first time.
The sand is fine; I sink halfway.
A shark's shadow passes far off.
I memorize this stone.
Six points of health to grow with.
A small cuttlefish, hidden behind the reef.

lines.zh: 水一烫，我的腕足全卷了。
lines.en: Hot water curls every one of my arms.

lines.zh: 我被甩到礁上，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I was flung onto the reef; my bone clicked.
No air left in the water; my mouth hangs open.

lines.zh: 炸开的水把我掀进珊瑚。
lines.en: The blast threw me into the coral.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我背上的鳍。
lines.en: An arrow went through the fin on my back.
Something has locked me in place.
No crabs on the reef; I go soft with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅海，我全身一缩。
lines.en: Lightning hit the shallows; I clamped shut.
The water vanished; I dropped.
